Omar Ruiz: Starting Aurelia Labs onboarding prep - internal roll call. Quick internal dry run tomorrow 8:30am PT? Need owners for enablement, tech walkthrough, and success metrics.
Hannah Moore: 8:30 works. Ill own the enablement session and the sample prompts.
Devon Lee: I can do the tech walkthrough (auth, webhooks, retry semantics). Need to confirm whether they're doing streaming or batch inference.
Priya Nair: I'll take success criteria and the 30-day healthboard. Early flag: procurement window: contract signed but pace to prod matters for renewal. If no pilot by day 30, classify as "at-risk".
Omar Ruiz: Key customer contacts: Mei Chen (Aurelia PM), Andre Suarez (data infra), Lena Park (security). Internal: Omar (CS Lead), Hannah (Enablement), Devon (SE), Priya (CS Ops).
Hannah Moore: Proposed 30-day targets: 1) Test app makes authenticated calls; 2) 4 validated prompts with quality >= 0.75; 3) Health dashboard + alerting; 4) Pilot traffic >= 100 calls/day.
Devon Lee: Tech timeline suggestion: Day 0-2 creds + test dataset; Day 3-7 integration + schema mapping; Day 8-14 validation + perf tuning; Day 15-30 pilot + feedback loop. If VPC requested, add security review +5 days.
Priya Nair: Renewal risk rules: mark "high" if no pilot traffic by day 30 OR if security blocks required data flow. I'll add a column on the board for mitigation actions.
Omar Ruiz: Quick risk mitigation: request expected QPS and vector volumes before kickoff, schedule a security pre-check on Day 1, and ask procurement for target go-live date.
Hannah Moore: I'll prepare a 25-min enablement deck + 10-min developer quickstart. Uploading draft here: https://redwood.internal/cs/aurelia/enablement-draft (placeholder).
Devon Lee: Adding a small code snippet for the quickstart, will push to the repo:
```python
# basic redwood call example
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', json={'model':'rwd-gen','input':'Summarize meeting notes'})
print(resp.json())
```
